observations.body: A community receives the message, turns, and waits. Paul, Silvanus, and Timothy, to the assembly of the Thessalonians in God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ. and to wait for his Son from heaven, whom he raised from the dead: Jesus, who delivers us from the wrath to come.

payload.posture: Read 1 Thessalonians 1:1–10 as one movement in Paul's story, keeping the passage's actions, setting, sequence, and limits visible.
payload.tension: The passage states a community receives the message, turns, and waits. Paul, Silvanus, and Timothy, to the assembly of the Thessalonians in God the Father and the Lord Jesus Christ: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ. and to wait for his Son from heaven, whom he raised from the dead: Jesus, who delivers us from the wrath to come. It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of Paul's story.
